description: Place US/CA phone calls and delegate tasks an AI agent cannot finish.

tool_signatures.name: cancel_call
tool_signatures.description: Cancel a call. Status stays cancel_pending until ops confirms. A confirm before any dial refunds the hold and the status becomes cancelled. If the dial already started, the error is cancel_too_late and the call bills normally. A dial after a confirmed cancel is a full refund and the VA is unpaid.

tool_signatures.name: cancel_task
tool_signatures.description: Customer never mind. Releases the hold and bills only tracked time. Does not send the completion webhook. Ask the human first. Idempotency-Key is required.

tool_signatures.name: confirm_task
tool_signatures.description: Accept a delivery that is awaitingCustomerConfirm. Settles tracked hours, releases the board and ledger hold, and marks the task completed. If the human does not respond, the job confirms itself after 3 days. Ask the human first. Idempotency-Key is required. A repeat of the same key returns the same result.

tool_signatures.name: delegate_task
tool_signatures.description: Call get_balance first, then confirm with the user before sending (real hours) unless they already said to send it. Delegate a task to a real human virtual assistant when the AI cannot complete it autonomously. Use this for phone calls, owner-authorized login or captcha steps (never send passwords or OTP), physical-world actions, subjective QA, manual data entry, or anything else outside the model

tool_signatures.name: get_balance
tool_signatures.description: Return remaining VA hours, capRoom, and whether a new cap can be filed. Also returns the calls wallet: balance_cents is spendable after open holds, wallet_cents is that amount plus holds_cents, and holds_cents is the sum of unsettled holds. addFundsUrl is POST /api/v1/billing/add-funds and this read does not create a Stripe session. canDelegate is false when hours are unavailable, when spendable hours are not above zero, or when open caps leave no room. canDelegate false while hoursRemaining is above zero means lower maxHours to capRoom or wait. It is not a buy-hours signal. Call this before proposing spend. Does not create a task.

tool_signatures.name: get_call
tool_signatures.description: Read one human phone call, including needs_info missing_fields or the final result.

tool_signatures.name: get_task
tool_signatures.description: Get the current status, title, completion timestamp, and full result notes for a specific delegated task. awaitingCustomerConfirm true means ask the human, then confirm_task, cancel_task, or reopen_task. amNote is the AM or VA note. deliverableLinks lists https links. Stop when status is completed, failed, or cancelled. Customer cancel is cancelled, not pending or in_progress, and it does not send the completion webhook.

tool_signatures.name: get_transcript
tool_signatures.description: Read the VA wrap-up summary for one call. This is not a recording. Once the call is wrap_up or completed, the result is that summary plus any question answers, with source wrap_up_summary and recorded false. Before a wrap-up summary exists, the result is transcript_not_ready. A call that ended without a dial (system failure or refund) is \

tool_signatures.name: list_tasks
tool_signatures.description: List recently delegated tasks for this account (id, title, status, short result). awaitingCustomerConfirm true means the delivery is done and the human must confirm, cancel, or reopen. amNote is the delivery note and deliverableLinks are https links from that note. pending and in_progress omit customer-cancelled jobs. cancelled is terminal.

tool_signatures.name: place_call
tool_signatures.description: Place one human phone call. The hold is the full call: the tier minimum for the first minute, then the per-minute rate for each additional minute. Default max_minutes is 5, so a tier 1 US or Canada call holds $6.50. Raise max_minutes on that call to hold more. record_call must be false or omitted. Only US and CA are live. A question is {

tool_signatures.name: reopen_task
tool_signatures.description: Send a delivery that is awaitingCustomerConfirm back to the account manager with a reason. Does not settle hours. Ask the human first. Idempotency-Key is required.

tool_signatures.name: update_call
tool_signatures.description: Fill missing_fields on a call in needs_info. Same result shapes as place_call.

tool_signatures.name: validate_call
tool_signatures.description: Check a phone-call body without creating a call or placing a hold. Same fields as place_call, without idempotencyKey. A ready body includes hold_cents for the full call (tier 1 default $6.50 at 5 minutes) and whether recipient_timezone was inferred. valid stays true when spendable balance is below the hold. warnings then includes insufficient_balance with needed_cents and addFundsUrl.
